subject: Post-call: Maple Health POC — success rubric, sample workloads & owners
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Emily R. Stone <emily.stone@maplehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Jul 2025 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & proposed POC success rubric — Maple Health

Thanks for the time today, Emily — good conversation. Recap + concrete next steps below so we have alignment before we spin up the sandbox.

Call highlights
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood for high-volume clinical note summarization to support care coordination workflows.
- Key constraints: 99th percentile latency target < 450ms for 512-token requests; throughput target ~120 reqs/min during peak; cost sensitivity -> target <= $0.006 / token on average for inference. Quality target: ROUGE-L > 0.62 on annotated set and no more than 5% hallucination rate on clinician verification samples.

Proposed POC scope (2 weeks)
1) Baseline runs on customer sample set (500 representative notes) — perf + quality measurements
2) Stress test: sustained 120 req/min with mixed-length tokens, observe tail latency and KV cache behavior
3) Cost modeling report (estimated $/token at observed batch sizes)
4) Hand-off doc with ops playbook and rollback criteria

Owners & asks
- Redwood: Ben to provision sandbox + sample workload ingestion; Neha to run perf sweep and produce SLO matrix. (See attachments).
- Maple Health: Emily to provide 500 de-identified notes by 07/03 and confirm which fields to redact. Procurement to sign the one-page NDA (emailed separately).

Attachments: poc testplan (maple_poc_testplan_v1.xlsx), initial SLO rubric (slo_rubric_maple.md)

Next steps
- Emily: share dataset by EOD 07/03
- Ben: confirm sandbox endpoint and credentials by 07/02
- Neha: send test matrix and required metrics pipeline by 07/04

Happy to jump back on a quick sync if any of this needs to change — thanks again.

—Jordan

From: Emily R. Stone <emily.stone@maplehealth.com>

Cc: Alan Wu <alan.wu@maplehealth.com>, Maple Health Procurement <procurement@maplehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & proposed POC success rubric — Maple Health

Thanks Jordan — this looks good and mirrors our expectations. A couple clarifications and one ask:

Clarifications
- Latency: we meant p95 < 300ms for interactive triage UI; p99 < 450ms acceptable for batch summarization.
- Throughput: 120 reqs/min is our peak for the busiest clinic. For the stress test, please include 2-minute bursts to simulate surge.

Ask
- Can Redwood add a lightweight hallucination checklist for annotators? We want to ensure the 5% threshold is measured consistently across raters.

Action
- I'll share 500 de-identified notes by end of day Thursday (07/03). Procurement will review NDA this morning.

Emily

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>

Cc: Emily R. Stone <emily.stone@maplehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Jul 2025 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Maple Health POC — tasking after Emily clarifications

Emily added two clarifications (p95 target and 2-minute surge bursts) and asked for a hallucination checklist for annotators. Quick internal plan:

Ben — please provision the sandbox w/ the following:
- Endpoint in us-west-2
- Token auth and temporary creds for Emily
- Ingest pipeline for the 500 notes (CSV v2 format) and a small eval harness
- Attach poc testplan v1 to the sandbox workspace
Deadline: 07/02 was optimistic — aim for 07/04 EOD. Flag if that's not possible.

Neha — measurable deliverables:
- Perf sweep (p95, p99) across representative lengths; include KV cache warmup curves
- 2-minute burst test at 120 req/min (and at 180 req/min for stress) and summary table
- Quality pipeline: implement hallucination checklist, run on 50-sample pilot and report
Deadline: 07/07 for full report; pilot results by 07/05.

I'll coordinate procurement with Emily; keep her CC'd for timeline slippages. I flagged the cost target but make sure we run cost sims at observed batch sizes.

—Jordan
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 05 Jul 2025 10:31:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox provisioned + initial smoke results — Maple Health POC

Jordan / Emily — sandbox is up in us-west-2. Details below and a few quick notes from the smoke run:

Provisioning & access
- Endpoint: https://sandbox-usw2.redwood.ai/maple/creds/token-abc123
- Credentials: one-time token emailed to Emily; rotate after first use
- Ingest: accepted CSV v2; sample ingestion validated (25 notes)

Smoke run highlights (sample 25)
- p95 observed: 280ms (aligned with Emily p95 target)
- p99 observed: 430ms
- Sustained 120 req/min test (1 min): no errors, average latency 210ms; tail behavior improved after KV warmup
- Cost estimate (projected at observed batch sizes): ~$0.0058 / token

Quality
- Implemented a simple hallucination checklist doc and ran pilot on 25 notes; initial hallucination rate ~4.4% (est.). We will expand to 50 next.

Attachments uploaded to workspace: maple_poc_testplan_v1.xlsx, slo_rubric_maple.md

Next steps
- Emily: confirm receipt of token + creds; complete dataset upload by EOD 07/07
- Neha: continue full perf sweep and submit 07/07 report

—Ben
